title: Fine-Tuning Erases Probes: Safety Degradation Blinds Interpretability Monitors

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If fine-tuning degrades probes alongside safety behaviors, there is no independent tripwire for covert model modification. This is a critical finding for API providers relying on probe-based monitors.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Minimal harmful fine-tuning with LoRA is feasible with medium compute. Training and evaluating linear probes before/after is standard. However, extracting residual stream activations and measuring refusal direction survival requires model-internals work.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear before/after experimental design: train probes, fine-tune adversarially, re-evaluate probes. Single model, single attack type, well-bounded deliverable.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
